rationale: Although NVDA exhibits strong downward momentum—gapping up to $169.91 and selling off on 4.45x relative volume below both VWAP ($162.97) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($161.69)—the last five 1-minute candles are consolidating sideways in a tight range between $159.88 and $160.77 near the session low ($159.21). Initiating a short near the bottom 10% of the day's range offers poor immediate reward-to-risk before a breakdown or pullback toward dynamic resistance, while going long fights dominant institutional selling pressure and a weak broader market. Given that nearly 80% of portfolio buying power is already committed, waiting for a clearer structural trigger is optimal.
